Our trusted reading shelf

Islamic learning & references ✧

Keep these helpful places close for Qur’an, tafsir, supplications, hadith study and guidance from qualified scholars.

Quran.com ↗Qur’an text, translations, recitation and tafsirIslamQA.info ↗Scholar-written answers and source discussionsMyIslam.org ↗Accessible duʿa guides, transliterations and studyHadith Encyclopedia ↗Translated hadiths with grading and explanationsIslamWeb ↗Scholar-reviewed fatwas, worship and supplicationsYaqeen Institute ↗Scholarly research on faith and living Islam

Qur’anic duʿas in Sakinah are linked to their verses. Prophetic supplications are linked to referenced hadith discussions. Other websites have different editorial standards and jurisprudential approaches; for personal religious rulings, consult qualified scholars you trust. Every supplication has a linked reference.
